title: 第30章 清点第31章 暗涌
content_zh:
沐云在扫荡完整个市场之后，突然眼皮一跳，沐云立时有了感应。
＂想要查我？呵呵...你慢慢查吧！祝你好运。＂沐云心中坏坏的想道。
尽管沐云现在这具身体枚有＂全知＂和＂真知＂的能力，但是在怎样说，他的本源也依旧是Ｚ级的存在，所有针对他的一切事物，他都还是能有所感应的，更遑论他还保有着＂真实＂的力量。
摇了摇头，沐云决定先不去理会，反正到时候有的是机会炮制他们。
沐云这一次扫光了益、凉两州的绝大部分交易单，花费了七万多枚金币，但是收获也是极其惊人。
各类矿石资源收获了一百七十万单位，平均一单位30铜币，总计花费5100枚金币。
各类木头资源收获了五百一十万单位，平均一单位15铜币，总计花费7650枚金币。
各类粮食资源收获了三千五百七十万单位，平均一单位5铜币，总计花费枚金币。
各类石头资源收获了三百一十万单位，平均一单位10铜币，总计花费3100枚金币。
各类基础药材收获了七十八万单位，平均一单位25铜币，总计花费1950枚金币。
各类高品质矿石资源收获了十四万单位，平均一单位2银币，总计花费2800枚金币。
各类高品质木头资源收获了三十一万单位，平均一单位2银币，总计花费6200枚金币。
各类高品质粮食资源收获了八十九万单位，平均一单位50铜币，总计花费4450枚金币。
各类高品质石头资源收获了一百二十二万单位，平均一单位1银币50铜币，总计花费枚金币。
各类高品质基础药材收获了十八万单位，平均一单位3银币，总计花费5400枚金币。
基本上，这些资源够沐云使用到领地升到城级还有富余。而所有资源当中，沐云最重视的便是粮食和药材资源的储备。
一单位的粮食，可供十人食用一餐，而长期服用高品质的粮食，能使原住民ＮＰＣ拥有更好的基础，在未来也更容易晋级。
在第一次历史剧情前半年开始，全＂帝望＂各国便会出现一个个不同种类的天灾，粮食产出的总量便会开始下滑。而玩家在不久后的未来，便会纷纷的建立起个人领地，一旦开始训练军队，粮食的消耗便会急遽增加。届时，粮价便会急速上升，就是想买也买不到。
在冷冰器时代，最可怕的不是战乱，而是战乱后所引发的疾病。这些药材在沐云的规划中，有一大部份是要拿来培育的。在忘忧谷的环境中，有了这些药材为基底，未来不说产出贩售，至少供应忘忧谷的正常消耗是绰绰有余的。
其他诸如矿石，木头，石头这些，主要是要维持领地建设使用。毕竟，忘忧村的人口有限，如果在将大部分的人力放在资源开采上面，建设的速度将极为缓慢，到时候可能会无法达到沐云所预期的目标。

其中矿石的部份，有一半是沐云准备拿来练习锻造用的，尤其是那些高品质矿石。
全知不等于全能，但是全知可以近乎全能！这是沐云的座右铭。
沐云的脑海中，有着太多太多的知识了，但是要将这些知识变成能力，还是免不了要亲身锻炼的，只不过沐云与他人不同的地方，在于他可以直接避过弯路，向着终点前行。
在清点完收获之后，沐云再度将目光放回了忘忧村的建设当中。
领地名称：忘忧村
村长：沐云（可更改选项：九世木鱼）
副村长：章群
领地等级：三等村级领地
现有建筑：三等村长居所一座，民居六座，酒肆一座，医馆一座，布庄一座，绣庄一座，书院一座，藏书阁一座，大型市场一座，大型物资仓库两座，大型粮仓两座，渔场一座，演武场一座，大型军营一座，衙府一座，兵武库一座，大型铁匠坊一座，大型木匠坊一座，大型石匠坊一座，大型客栈一座，大型马厩一座
拥有建筑模板：铁匠铺，木匠房，石匠房，民居，物资仓库，粮仓，围墙，采矿场，伐木场，采石场，码头，集市，了台，操练场
拥有特殊建筑：九重府库
现有附属设施：农田一块
content_en:
After Mu Yun swept the entire market, his eyelids suddenly twitched, and Mu Yun immediately felt something.
"You want to check me? Haha... Just check it slowly! I wish you good luck." Mu Yun thought evilly in his heart.
Although Mu Yun's current body has the ability of "omniscience" and "true knowledge", his origin is still a Z-level existence. He can still sense everything that targets him, not to mention that he still retains the power of "realness".
Shaking his head, Mu Yun decided to ignore it for now. Anyway, there would be plenty of opportunities to deal with them then.
Mu Yun swept away most of the transactions in Yi and Liang states this time, spending more than 70,000 gold coins, but the harvest was also extremely amazing.
1.7 million units of various ore resources were harvested, with an average of 30 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 5,100 gold coins.
5.1 million units of various wood resources were harvested, with an average of 15 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 7,650 gold coins.
35.7 million units of various food resources were harvested, with an average of 5 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 1 gold coin.
3.1 million units of various stone resources were harvested, with an average of 10 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 3,100 gold coins.
780,000 units of various basic medicinal materials were harvested, with an average of 25 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 1,950 gold coins.
One hundred and forty thousand units of various high-quality ore resources were harvested, with an average of 2 silver coins per unit and a total cost of 2,800 gold coins.
310,000 units of various high-quality wood resources were harvested, with an average of 2 silver coins per unit and a total cost of 6,200 gold coins.
890,000 units of various high-quality food resources were harvested, with an average of 50 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 4,450 gold coins.
1.22 million units of various high-quality stone resources were harvested, with an average of 1 silver coin and 50 copper coins per unit, and a total cost of 1 gold coin.
180,000 units of various high-quality basic medicinal materials were harvested, with an average of 3 silver coins per unit, and a total cost of 5,400 gold coins.
Basically, these resources are enough for Mu Yun to use until the territory reaches the city level and there is still a surplus. Among all resources, Mu Yun's most important thing is the reserve of food and medicinal resources.
One unit of food can feed ten people for one meal, and long-term consumption of high-quality food can give indigenous NPCs a better foundation and make it easier to advance in the future.
Starting from the first half year of the first historical plot, different types of natural disasters will occur in various countries across the "Emperor's Hope", and the total amount of food output will begin to decline. In the near future, players will establish personal territories one after another. Once they start training their troops, food consumption will increase rapidly. By then, food prices will rise rapidly, making it impossible to buy even if you want to.
In the Cold War, the most terrifying thing was not the war, but the diseases caused by the war. In Mu Yun's plan, a large part of these medicinal materials are to be cultivated. In the environment of Wangyou Valley, with these medicinal materials as the basis, not to mention the output and sales in the future, at least it will be more than enough to supply the normal consumption of Wangyou Valley.
Others, such as ores, wood, and stones, are mainly used to maintain the construction of the territory. After all, the population of Wangyou Village is limited. If most of the manpower is focused on resource extraction, the construction speed will be extremely slow, and Mu Yun may not be able to achieve the goals expected by then.
Half of the ores were used by Mu Yun to practice forging, especially the high-quality ores.
Omniscience does not mean omnipotence, but omniscience can be close to omnipotence! This is Mu Yun's motto.
Mu Yun has too much knowledge in his mind, but to turn this knowledge into abilities, he still has to practice it himself. But what makes Mu Yun different from others is that he can directly avoid detours and move towards the end.
After counting the harvest, Mu Yun looked at the harvest againThe light was put back into the construction of Wangyou Village.
Territory name: Wangyou Village
Village Chief: Mu Yun (optional changeable: Ninth World Muyu)
Deputy village head: Zhang Qun
Territory level: third-class village level territory
Existing buildings: a third-class village chief's residence, six residential buildings, a wine shop, a medical center, a cloth shop, an embroidery shop, an academy, a library, a large market, two large material warehouses, two large granaries, a fishing ground, a martial arts field, a large military camp, a government office, an arsenal, a large blacksmith's workshop, a large carpenter's workshop, a large stonemason's workshop, a large inn, and a large stable.
Possess building templates: blacksmith shop, carpenter's house, mason's house, residence, material warehouse, granary, fence, mining field, lumberyard, quarry, wharf, market, platform, training ground
Owns a special building: Jiuchong Treasury
Existing ancillary facilities: a piece of farmland
